verdict.rationale: The docs show Teams bots/agents that users chat with and that take part in conversations (quickstart, bots that 'initiate and participate', porting Slack Bolt apps). Outgoing Webhooks push channel text messages to a web service, so a bot can receive messages, but the pack never describes the real-time event delivery mechanism itself. Missing for 10: documentation of the bot messaging endpoint or event subscription model, coverage of non-message events (reactions, membership, conversation updates) as inbound events, delivery or latency details, and independent hands-on corroboration.
